description: Revert to the empirically proven "Gold Standard" configuration (Depth=8, Matrix LR=0.06, WD=0.1, Batch=128) which has consistently yielded the best val_bpb (~0.9904-0.9905) across multiple runs, while explicitly removing the aggressive LR=0.07/WD=0.08 and conservative LR=0.055/WD=0.12 experiments that degraded performance or caused instability.
